algorithm.coefficient_origin: Invented for the demo; not fitted to observations or clinically validated.
algorithm.formula: score = min(100, base + additional_rules + age_bonus + weight_bonus + quantity_bonus)
algorithm.quantity_formula: per edge: round(min(20, max(0, 10 * (sqrt((daily_a/reference_a) * (daily_b/reference_b)) - 1)))); overall quantity_bonus = max(edge bonuses)
algorithm.quantity_note: Invented exposure heuristic. Reference = one selected presentation unit, not a therapeutic dose. No dose-response evidence. Missing amounts or normalization: quantity bonus not computed. Lower quantities never remove a workbook alert.
algorithm.units: fictional demo points, not a probability or percentage
